title: MED+250 prescription access and retention policy approval
summary: Owner-ready approval record for the implemented private prescription lifecycle. Technical cleanup and access tests are complete, but privacy, legal-basis, role assignment and incident acceptance require the named privacy owner.

checks.name: Private access boundary
checks.detail: The policy limits file access to the customer and selected pharmacy, with unrelated recipients excluded and signed links capped by the remaining selection window.

checks.name: Implemented retention periods
checks.detail: The policy records the deployed 24-hour orphan rule, 24-hour selected-pharmacy access window and 30-day completed-request deletion rule.

checks.name: Cleanup schedule and concurrency safety
checks.detail: The policy records the protected six-hour schedule, 15-minute lease, path-grouped reference proof, deletion-before-reference-clearing rule and retry recovery behavior.

checks.name: Controlled technical test
checks.detail: The existing redacted test record confirms the deployed retention and access controls without exposing prescription, customer, pharmacy or precise-location data.

checks.name: Privacy and legal acceptance
checks.detail: The privacy owner has not yet recorded the applicable legal basis, controller and processor roles, transfer conditions, notification obligations or any required policy conditions.

checks.name: Named incident roles and signature
checks.detail: The privacy owner must assign the accountable privacy and security incident contacts, approve the periods and safeguards, and sign this artifact.

completion_instructions: Review the policy with the applicable Rwanda privacy, health-data and pharmaceutical obligations.
Assign the accountable privacy and security incident contacts in the controlled staff register.
Record any legal-basis, controller, processor, transfer, notification or retention conditions in the redacted decision.
Confirm both recorded SHA-256 values still match their files.
Set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the approver, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate the artifact strictly and add it to data/launch-evidence.json with its exact SHA-256 digest.
